summary: ObjectGenome generation-7 has no explicit canonical work/cardinality budget for components, supportKeys, mechanisms, affordances, mutable state maps, or validation issue accumulation. This is a concrete bounded-work gap, but imposing v1 limits would narrow previously accepted canonical data, so implementation needs an explicit contract decision rather than an opportunistic validator edit.
evidence: PR #380 exact head 0250b26afa018959f1aec450830680361d1a3dc2 is the current retained ObjectGenome generation-7 successor; its independent audit is already owned by another worker.

ObjectGenome.luau validates components as a dense non-empty array and then iterates every component/support edge; it defines semantic-key byte and familyVersion bounds but no collection-cardinality constants.

The same validator iterates every mechanism and affordance and appends structured issues without an explicit issue-count budget; inspectState likewise iterates all required/received mutable state-map keys.
Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md specifies dense array shape and deterministic diagnostics but no maximum collection/state-map cardinalities or total canonical recipe byte budget.

tests/object_genome.luau intentionally accepts otherwise-valid provenance productLine content longer than 512 bytes and verifies fingerprinting it, confirming that the existing contract does not generally cap non-identity recipe strings.
Repository PR/issue search found no existing ObjectGenome cardinality/bounded-work lane or issue matching components/mechanisms/affordances capacity terminology.
